title: Obed Edom
summary: Raleigh names Obed Edom in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). The family of Obed Edom had hereditarie charge of the treasurie. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXII, §. IX, sig. 331b–332a
